CweFindings.Name: Unchecked Input for Loop Condition
CweFindings.Description: The product does not properly check inputs that are used for loop conditions, potentially leading to a denial of service or other consequences because of excessive looping.
CweFindings.Explanation: HomeController.uploadPhotos iterates over every MultipartFile supplied in the request (lines 57-69) without enforcing an item-count cap. The configuration declares app.file-upload.max-files-per-upload=10, but it is not consumed by the controller or service, so an attacker can drive the loop with an oversized list of multipart parts.

CweFindings.Name: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
CweFindings.Description: The product allows the upload or transfer of dangerous file types that are automatically processed within its environment.
CweFindings.Explanation: PhotoServiceImpl.uploadPhoto (lines 87-94) validates only MultipartFile.getContentType(), which is controlled by the upload request. The bytes are then persisted even when ImageIO finds no reader (lines 122-149). PhotoFileController.servePhoto (lines 57-76) returns those bytes with the stored client-provided MIME type, so the content/type allowlist can be bypassed by labeling arbitrary bytes as an allowed image type.
